label.ro: sawal zyada tar Microsoft exams mein

label.en: to pass; a scaled score, not 70% of the questions
label.ro: pass ke liye; ye scaled score hai, 70% sawal nahi

label.en: points lost for a wrong answer
label.ro: number kam hote hain ghalat jawab par

items.en: Read the official study guide and check the “skills measured” date. This portal follows the version of 15 April 2026.
items.ro: Official study guide parhein aur “skills measured” ki tareekh dekhein. Ye portal 15 April 2026 wali version par hai.

items.en: If the exam is not offered in your preferred language, request 30 extra minutes. Request this and any other accommodation before you book; it can take up to 20 days.
items.ro: Agar exam aap ki pasandeeda zabaan mein nahi, to 30 izafi minute ki darkhwast dein. Ye aur koi bhi accommodation book karne se pehle maangein; is mein 20 din tak lag sakte hain.

items.en: Make sure the name in your certification profile is exactly the name on your government-issued ID.
items.ro: Dekhein ke certification profile mein naam bilkul wahi ho jo aap ki sarkari ID par hai.

items.en: Decide between a test center and an online exam. Online you need a closed room, a webcam, a microphone and a computer with administrator rights.
items.ro: Test center ya online exam mein se chunein. Online ke liye band kamra, webcam, microphone aur administrator rights wala computer chahiye.

items.en: Try the exam sandbox once to learn the screens: every question type, mark for review, the review screen and the timer.
items.ro: Exam sandbox ek dafa azmayein taake screens samajh aayein: har qism ka sawal, mark for review, review screen aur timer.

items.en: Take the free Practice Assessment on Microsoft Learn and read the reason for each wrong answer.
items.ro: Microsoft Learn ka muft Practice Assessment dein aur har ghalat jawab ki wajah parhein.

items.en: Take one exam here under real conditions and study the weak areas afterwards.
items.ro: Yahan ek exam asal halaat mein dein aur baad mein kamzor hissay parhein.

items.en: Online: run the Pearson VUE system test on the same computer, in the same room and on the same network.
items.ro: Online: Pearson VUE ka system test usi computer, usi kamre aur usi network par chalayein.

items.en: Repeat the “which one when” tables of the lessons and your flashcards. Learn nothing new.
items.ro: Lessons ke “kab kaunsa” tables aur flashcards dohrayein. Koi nayi cheez na parhein.

items.en: Check the start time and time zone of your appointment and put your ID ready.
items.ro: Appointment ka waqt aur time zone dekhein aur ID tayyar rakhein.

items.en: Online: clear the desk, unplug extra monitors, put away books, notes, pens and watches.
items.ro: Online: mez saaf karein, izafi monitors nikalein, kitabein, notes, pens aur ghariyan hata dein.

items.en: Sleep. A rested head finds more points than one more hour of study.
items.ro: Neend poori karein. Taza dimagh ek aur ghante ki parhai se zyada number dilata hai.

items.en: Be early. Online you take photos of your ID, your face and the room with your phone, then put the phone out of reach.
items.ro: Jaldi pohanchein. Online mein phone se ID, chehre aur kamre ki tasveerein leni hain, phir phone pohanch se door rakhein.

items.en: Close all other programs, switch off notifications and use a wired connection if you can.
items.ro: Baqi tamam programs aur notifications band karein, aur ho sake to tar wala internet istemal karein.

items.en: Only a drink in a clear, spill-proof container is allowed. No food, no chewing gum, nobody else in the room.
items.ro: Sirf shaffaf, na girne wale bartan mein peene ki cheez ki ijazat hai. Khana, chewing gum ya kamre mein koi aur nahi.

items.en: Greeter and proctor speak English, also when your exam is in another language.
items.ro: Greeter aur proctor English mein baat karte hain, chahe exam doosri zabaan mein ho.

items.en: With 50 questions you have about 54 seconds each. After 15 minutes you should be near question 17, after 30 minutes near 34.
items.ro: 50 sawal hon to har sawal ke taqreeban 54 second hain. 15 minute baad sawal 17 aur 30 minute baad sawal 34 ke qareeb hon.

items.en: Answer, mark for review, move on. Do not stay longer than two minutes on one question in the first round.
items.ro: Jawab dein, mark for review karein, aage barhein. Pehle daur mein ek sawal par do minute se zyada na lagayein.

items.en: Answer every question. Nothing is deducted for a wrong answer, and you cannot see which questions are not scored.
items.ro: Har sawal ka jawab dein. Ghalat jawab par number kam nahi hote, aur pata nahi chalta ke kaunse sawal score mein nahi.

items.en: Most questions with several parts give a point for each correct part, so fill in all parts.
items.ro: Kai hisson wale zyada tar sawal har sahi hisse ka number dete hain, is liye tamam hisse bharein.

items.en: Microsoft Learn cannot be opened in a Fundamentals exam.
items.ro: Fundamentals exam mein Microsoft Learn nahi khulta.

items.en: You may take a break, but the clock continues and you cannot return to questions you saw before it. With 45 minutes it is better to avoid a break.
items.ro: Break le sakte hain, lekin ghari chalti rehti hai aur pehle dekhe hue sawalon par wapas nahi ja sakte. 45 minute mein break na lena behtar hai.

items.en: Read the last sentence first: what exactly is asked? Then mark the requirements such as lowest cost, least code, one region, live.
items.ro: Pehle aakhri jumla parhein: asal mein kya poocha hai? Phir zarooratein dekhein, jaise sab se kam kharcha, kam code, ek region, live.

items.en: Multiple answers: choose exactly as many as the question says (TWO, THREE).
items.ro: Kai jawab: bilkul utne chunein jitne sawal kehta hai (DO, TEEN).

items.en: Yes/No: judge each statement alone. All three can be Yes, or all three No.
items.ro: Haan/Nahi: har bayan ko alag parkhein. Teenon Haan bhi ho sakte hain aur teenon Nahi bhi.

items.en: Drop-down in code: read the lines around the blank; the variable names tell you what is needed.
items.ro: Code mein drop-down: khali jagah ke gird ki lines parhein; variables ke naam batate hain ke kya chahiye.

items.en: Matching and ordering: start with the pairs or steps you are sure about. Some choices stay unused.
items.ro: Matching aur tarteeb: jin jodon ya qadmon ka yaqeen hai un se shuru karein. Kuch options bach jate hain.

items.en: Two answers look right? Take the one that meets every requirement with the least effort.
items.ro: Do jawab sahi lagein? Woh lein jo kam se kam mehnat mein har zaroorat poori kare.

items.en: Sets that ask whether a solution meets the goal may not let you go back. Decide before you select Next.
items.ro: Jin sets mein poocha jata hai ke hal maqsad poora karta hai ya nahi, un mein wapas jana mumkin nahi ho sakta. Next se pehle faisla karein.

items.en: You see the result within minutes. The report shows a bar for each skill area, not the single questions.
items.ro: Nateeja chand minute mein milta hai. Report har skill area ki bar dikhati hai, alag alag sawal nahi.

items.en: Passed: your certification appears in your Microsoft Learn profile within about 24 hours. Azure AI Fundamentals does not expire.
items.ro: Pass: certification taqreeban 24 ghante mein Microsoft Learn profile mein aa jati hai. Azure AI Fundamentals expire nahi hoti.

items.en: Not passed: you can retake it after 24 hours. Each further attempt needs 14 days, with at most five attempts in 12 months.
items.ro: Fail: 24 ghante baad dobara de sakte hain. Us ke baad har koshish ke darmiyan 14 din, aur 12 mahine mein zyada se zyada paanch koshishein.

items.en: Use the shortest bar of the report as your next study section.
items.ro: Report ki sab se chhoti bar ko apna agla study section banayein.
